name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta province of Argentina. The project hosts a Measured & Indicated resource of 248 million ounces of silver and 2.5 million ounces of gold, with a pre-feasibility study delivering an after-tax NPV of US$494M and 26% IRR. The company is advancing toward a final investment decision and is backed by major shareholders including Eric Sprott and Kinross Gold.
